_comment: S188 CORPSE EATER — the zombie boss's feed. Built by scripts/build-scattered-sheet-atlas.mjs.
The owner's v2 sheets are already matted, 8x3, on a uniform 192 px pitch (measured, +/-3 px), with the
ground line drifting up to 26 px between rows — so uniform assignment + per-frame GROUND alignment.
⚠ A SEPARATE SHEET, NOT EXTRA ROWS IN t9boss-zombies (PROMPTS.md asked for rows, for one union bbox).
The union bbox's purpose — he must not change size when the skill fires — is met by FITTING instead:
the two STANDING frames (crouch-in 1, stand-and-burp 24) are scaled to the shipped idle's measured
body height (261/320, check-atlas-scenery's measure) and share its cell and foot anchor exactly.
Repacking the shipped sheet would have re-scaled four rows the owner already approved.
groundRowPx 312 = the shipped idle/walk/attack median body bottom (measured), so his feet do not drop.
feedLoop is the TILE_AND_REROLL §3 fix: the renderer PING-PONGS crouch-in 13-24, so the loop closes
by construction (the owner's own 'head down, eating, bringing it up, putting it down').
name: t9boss-zombies-feed
